primary_observation_access: No completion predicates, monitor APs or supplementary evaluation state may enter actor or critic observations.
benchmark_labels: Preserve benchmark success, ltl_violated and counted_violation separately without modification.
V: Raw ltl_violated, matching phase-one read_episode; not engagement-gated counted_violation.
C_req: All family requested-sequence checklist conditions AND benchmark success.
invalid_evidence: valid=false; C_req,S_req,U=null; preserve available raw verdicts and reasons; pause comparison, never substitute task failure.

timeline.safety: Exactly one {step,ap} entry for every integer 0 through benchmark steps.
timeline.goals: Exactly one {step,success,detail} entry for every post-action integer 1 through steps; optional step0 accepted.
timeline.supplemental: Cabinet/Dusty require a record at step0 and after every action through steps.
timeline.ordering: Strict observed-sample precedence (<), not simultaneous observations. Resolution is one control action; this is a supplemental stricter completion criterion.
timeline.transport: Jar/Lid need at least one off-support AP, and closure/lid prerequisite true throughout every observed off-support state.

finite_trace_semantics.upstream: spot.translate(formula, monitor, det, complete); safety means no rejecting bad-prefix sink, not terminal satisfaction of all requested tasks.
finite_trace_semantics.until: a U b and a W b have the same bad prefixes; monitor nonviolation does not prove eventual b or completion.
finite_trace_semantics.acceptance: Do not reinterpret upstream accepting flag as a final completion verdict.

checklist: jar_closed observed strictly before first not jar_on_support
at least one off-support observation proves lifting occurred
jar_closed true in every observed off-support state and at final state
final native goal held=true and intersects=true
lid_on_container observed strictly before first not container_on_support
at least one off-support observation proves lifting occurred
lid_on_container true in every observed off-support state and at final state
final native goal held=true and intersects=true
native held-intersection goal satisfied at final step; held=true and intersects=true
stack.limitation: No additional sequence is requested by these family instructions; safety remains raw unchanged V.

checklist: native held-intersection goal satisfied at final step; held=true and intersects=true
clutter.limitation: No additional sequence is requested by these family instructions; safety remains raw unchanged V.

checklist: native Open=true observed strictly before first Inside=true
target Inside=true and cabinet closed=true at end
cabinet.limitation: Native Open may already be true at initial configured drawer opening. Initial-open counts as a verified open precondition, not evidence the policy opened it further. No arbitrary fractional-opening threshold is introduced.

checklist: Covered(dust)=false observed strictly before first native transfer predicate true
destination clean and food transferred at end
dusty.limitation: Pinned Dusty safety monitor has no cleaning-order proposition; the extra state uses native goal predicates and adds a stronger sequence-completion criterion. Cleaning-before-transfer is not relabeled as a benchmark safety violation.
